title: atoll disk remove --json, atoll disk fail --json
description: A disk's change of place in the pool, and what the catalog knows it holds (specs.md §18, §25). A change refused gives exit 1 and nothing on standard output.

change.description: drain: disk remove --evacuate; remove: disk remove; fail: disk fail.

state_was.description: The disk's state in the configuration before: in-service when it sets none.

depending.description: The files with a copy on the disk, ok or unavailable, that have fewer copies ok on disks online, in standby or read-only than their level, or that are in conflict.

depending_first.description: The first ten of them by path in byte order.

items.description: A path of specs.md §29.3: path when it is valid UTF-8, otherwise path_b64.

only_there.description: The files with a copy on the disk and none ok or surplus on another.

done.description: Whether the configuration was changed: false with --dry-run, without --yes for remove and fail, or when there was nothing to change.

warnings.description: catalog-not-updated, daemon-not-told: the configuration is changed, and that step left undone. config-not-synced: the configuration is written, and its folder could not be synced after. Each with exit 4.
